stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: A note redraws the whole screen.

stations.title: Listeners
stations.text: Every part hears about every change.

stations.title: Your store
stations.gap: No way to watch one part

captions: Sefton types a note on the order screen, and every part of it is drawn again.
Each part listens to the whole state, so a note reaches the header too.
You let each part watch only what it shows, in three tasks.
Now a note draws the note box, and the header stays as it was.
Every part hears about its own part, and typing no longer lags.
